title: AD HOC COMMITTEE ON THE 2028 OLYMPICS AND PARALYMPIC GAMES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to preparation of activation zones and viewing parties relative to the…
text:
[Council File 15-0989-S37]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
AD HOC COMMITTEE ON THE 2028 OLYMPICS AND PARALYMPIC GAMES COMMITTEE REPORT relative to preparation of activation zones and viewing parties relative to the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games.
Recommendations for Council action:
1. INSTRUCT the Department of Recreation and Parks (RAP) to coordinate with the Chief Legislative Analyst (CLA), City Administrative Officer (CAO), the Office of the Mayor, Office of Major Events (OME), Council offices, relevant City departments, LA28, and other public and private stakeholders, to develop and report back on a City Activation Zone Program, with a budget and identified funding sources, that provides maximum public access to the Olympic and Paralympic experience; engages local vendors, artisans, and community groups; prioritizes local hiring and contracts; utilizes City volunteers; and provides quarterly reports in the lead-up to the 2028 Games. The report should include but not be limited to an evaluation of a two tiered approach to activations, incorporating the activation concepts presented in this report, while also identifying opportunities for smaller-scale, community-based activations that can bring Games-related programming to smaller neighborhood parks or public spaces not outlined in this report.
2. DIRECT the RAP and the Department of Cultural Affairs (DCA), and other affected City departments to report on strategies and the required resources, including an examination of renting or buying equipment, to implement the City Activation Zone Program, including estimated costs and funding opportunities; the report should identify the staffing, equipment, infrastructure, and funding necessary to support both flagship activations and/or smaller-scale community activations throughout the City.
3. INSTRUCT the RAP, in coordination with the CLA, CAO, DCA, and OME, to report with a program management strategy, including a Managing Producer concept, and initiate preparation of documents necessary to initiate procurement of key operational components of the program.
4. REQUEST the City Attorney, in coordination with CLA, CAO, OME, and RAP, to report on the City's policies and procedures for obtaining and securing sponsorships for the City Activation Zone Program.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The CAO and the CLA report that approval of the recommendations in its report do not result in any fiscal impact on the General Fund. City Activation Zone Program is expected to require substantial funding from the General Fund in the future 2027-28 and 2028-29 Budgets. Financial policies The CAO and the CLA report that approval of the recommendations in the report statement complies with the City's Financial Policies.
Community Impact Statement:
Yes
summary: Council directs the Recreation and Parks Department and other agencies to develop a City Activation Zone Program for the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games, including activations for smaller neighborhood parks and public spaces, with budget, funding, procurement and sponsorship reports.
